incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: KMS decrypt error rate spike (service=kms-frontend, region=us-west-2) — PagerDuty incident PD#98765 fired — playbook: kms-decrypt-failure
pagerduty: Incident PD#98765 — triggered for service: kms-frontend. Acknowledge to stop notifications.
sam_oncall: acked — I'm taking this. seeing lots of 429s and 'Key not found' errors in the last 3m. can someone post quick metrics?
maria_sre: digging into CloudWatch now. 429s correlate with increased decrypt latency and retries. also seeing a bump in HSM RPC timeouts to the ksm-hsm cluster.
jess_oncall: any recent changes? key rotation started around 16:02 UTC per deploy logs.
sam_oncall: confirmed rotation job kicked at 16:01:58 UTC for key-id: redwood-prod-2026-03. suspicious timing.
eng-lead: tagging @maria_sre and @jess_oncall — if rotation is causing key lookup mismatch we might hit 'Key not found' when callers hit old key IDs during rollover.
maria_sre: logs from kms-frontend (snippet):
```
ERROR kms-frontend - decrypt failed for request id=abcd-1234: status=429 message="throttled by hsm" attempts=3
WARN ksm-hsm - lookup failed key=redwood-prod-2026-03: not_found
ERROR ksm-hsm - rpc timeout to HSM node i-0abc123: context deadline exceeded
```
ops-bot: @sam_oncall — current KMS TPS: 620 (baseline 120), KMS throttled calls: 38% in last 5m, HSM queue depth 84%.
sam_oncall: ok two concurrent problems: (1) rotation causing key ID mismatch for a subset of traffic -> 404s, (2) HSM throttling/timeouts causing 429s. mitigation plan: 1) pause rotation if possible, 2) route traffic to older key alias until rotation completes, 3) increase KMS frontend retry/backoff and enable cache fallback for decrypted keys.
jess_oncall: how do we pause rotation? which system? it's an orchestration job in infra-controlplane.
eng-lead: @ops-bot can you run: infra-controlplane cancel-rotation --key redwood-prod-2026-03 ?
ops-bot: Command queued: infra-controlplane cancel-rotation --key redwood-prod-2026-03. status: in_progress.
maria_sre: while that's running, I'm patching the KMS client to tolerate NotFound by trying alias resolution via alias/redwood-prod and falling back to latest stable key-id. rolling patch to 20% of frontend first.
sam_oncall: good. jess, can you start a targeted takeover for 3 highest-error nodes and restart KMS worker to flush stuck HSM sessions? use: kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/kms-worker --selector=zone=us-west-2a --timeout=5m
jess_oncall: doing restart now on us-west-2a, then west-2b. posting logs.
(5m later)
jess_oncall: restart done for zone a. errors decreased ~30% on that subset.
maria_sre: cancel-rotation completed (infra-controlplane): rotation job terminated at 16:13:02 UTC. alias mapping restored to point at previous key-id.
ops-bot: metrics update: KMS TPS down to 210, throttled calls 6%, HSM queue 45%.
sam_oncall: nice. verify client fallback is live in 3 pods; toggling feature flag to 100% in 2m.
eng-lead: customer impact? any SLOs breached / major customers impacted?
jess_oncall: initial impact window: 16:01–16:14 UTC. error budget consumption estimate: spike caused 0.9% of global requests to error — some streaming customers in us-west-2 had toast on decrypt calls for feature X.
maria_sre: prepared status blurb for support: "Between 16:01 and 16:14 UTC, a KMS key rotation coincided with elevated HSM latency causing decrypt failures and throttling in us-west-2. Rotation has been paused and alias mappings restored. Full client fallback enabled; restarts reduced HSM queue. Monitoring shows recovery to normal. Root cause investigation ongoing."
sam_oncall: I'm going to mark this as mitigated but not resolved. creating incident ticket PD#98765 -> INC-2026-03-15-KMS-ROT. I'll hand off to night oncall in 30m.
pagerduty: PD#98765 acknowledged by sam_oncall. escalation stopped.
eng-lead: good job. action items: 1) infra to add pre-rotation canary checks for HSM queue depth, 2) implement alias-level atomic swap to avoid transient not_found, 3) increase HSM connection pool, 4) refine alert to separate 'key-not-found' during rotation from general decrypt throttling.
maria_sre: adding postmortem template entry now. I'll collect logs and correlate HSM node faults.
jess_oncall: copied. if anything spikes again ping me, I'll take immediate hands-on.
sam_oncall: handoff note: mitigation applied, rotation canceled, client fallback forced, pods restarted in zones a/b, monitoring normal. leaving PD incident open for RCA. handing to @jess_oncall in 30m.
(30m later)
jess_oncall: taking over. will continue RCA and coordinate postmortem write-up.
incident-bot: Incident PD#98765 status: mitigated -> awaiting RCA. closing pagers.
